view.name: view_metric_query_source
view.yaml:
version: 0.1
source: SELECT * FROM `{catalog}`.`{schema}`.orders WHERE price > 0
dimensions:
  - name: order_id
    expr: order_id
  - name: price
    expr: price

why: A metric view whose source is a query, which Databricks accepts and the reference refuses by name (ViewConversionError, DB/metric_view.py:779-790), raised by the client as StructuredDataError INVALID_REQUEST (CL/materializers/sources.py:276). The view is created in the test schema from the yaml, its sources named with the {catalog} and {schema} placeholders the capture writes (no private name), each part backtick-quoted since Databricks reads a catalog's hyphen only quoted; its joins' on keys are bare, as people write them, so PyYAML reads each as the key true (KO3-40), which the reference reads too (DB/metric_view.py:825-909, join_cfg.get(True))
